restaurantName: Japanese Afternoon Tea at Ginza St James's
bio: Indulge in a delicious pairing of a British quintessential tradition and authentic Japanese cuisine with this Afternoon Tea for Two at Ginza, St James.  Located in the heart of Mayfair, Ginza St. James’s has elegant and stylish décor. Using the finest ingredients, the menu celebrates traditional Japanese cooking styles prepared by a talented team of chefs.  Enjoy a culinary journey through Japan as you are served a wide array of savoury delicacies including Teriyaki Beef and Black Cod Croquette, followed by decadent desserts like Japanese Custard with black treacle as well as mango and green tea Mochi.  All your fantastic food will be accompanied by a selection of traditional Japanese teas to choose from.  Buy gift vouchers for Afternoon Tea at Ginza St. James’s – Japanese Restaurant - View Details
